$schema: Cross-language test fixtures for the V162 budget guard formula.
description: Single source of truth used by both BudgetGuardParityTest (Java JUnit) and budgetGuards.parity.test.mjs (JS Jest). When the formula changes, update this file - both runners will then enforce the new behavior. Pattern mirrors agent-stop-reason.json.
formula: projectedNext = max(growthProj, lastDeltaProj × LAST_DELTA_SAFETY_FACTOR, cacheMissProj, worstCaseSingleIter); deny iff (runCostSoFar + projectedNext > balance) OR (runCostSoFar >= balance). Every cost prices each input class at its own rate: the prompt is split into plain input / cache write / cache read by the provider's shape (claude-code: prompt includes the cache; anthropic, claude: cache counted beside the prompt; everyone else: cached tokens are a subset of the prompt), then plain × inputRate + write × cacheWriteRate + read × cacheReadRate. cacheMissProj is the last iteration priced as a cache miss (its reads at cacheWriteRate) for a provider whose prompt total carries the cache, and 0 for the Anthropic API (anthropic, claude), whose guard never reserved anything for its additive cache. A row with neither cacheReadRate nor cacheWriteRate keeps the pre-change formula (every prompt token at inputRate, cache counters ignored); one missing rate alone falls back to inputRate.
optionalInputs: cacheCreationTokens, cacheReadTokens, cachedTokens (run totals) and lastCacheCreationTokens, lastCacheReadTokens, lastCachedTokens (latest iteration) default to 0; cacheReadRate and cacheWriteRate default to null.

cases.name: regression_minus11305_step_function_burst
cases.description: The actual bug: 31 cruise iters at ~70k prompt tokens each, balance ~2308 left. WorstCase for V162-seeded claude-code/claude-opus-4-6 (200K ctx + 64K out at 15/75 USD per 1M) = 200×15 + 64×75 = 3000 + 4800 = 7800 credits. consumed + worstCase >> balance → DENY before iter 32 burst lands.

cases.name: first_iteration_no_history_proceeds
cases.description: On iter 1, lastDelta is 0 and avg over 0 iters is 0. Without worstCase, projection is 0 and the guard must allow the first call (otherwise no run can ever start).

cases.name: balance_exhausted_proceeds_false_immediately
cases.description: consumed >= balance must short-circuit even before projection kicks in.

cases.name: step_function_burst_caught_by_lastDelta_safety_factor
cases.description: Cruise at ~5k/iter for 5 iters, then iter 5 spikes to +50k delta. lastDelta×2 = 100k tokens × 0.005 ≈ 500 credits. Balance 600 left → projected next > balance → DENY without needing worstCase.

cases.name: comfortable_balance_with_known_worstCase_proceeds
cases.description: Balance >> worstCase so the run can proceed normally. Sonnet 200K ctx + 8K out at 3/15 ≈ 720 credits worstCase; balance 5000 → headroom.

cases.name: gemini_2m_below_window_proceeds
cases.description: Gemini 2.0 Pro 2M context. PromptTokens 1.8M is under 95% of window - guard must NOT deny based on a hard 2M global cap (the v1 mistake). worstCase ≈ 2M × 1.25/1M + 65K × 5/1M = 2500 + 325 = 2825 credits; balance 10000 → proceed.

cases.name: missing_ctx_window_legacy_falls_back_to_growth_only
cases.description: Pre-V162 row has null contextWindow / maxOutputTokens. Without the requireCtxWindow flag, guard must fall back to growth-only projection (legacy behavior - don't break existing snapshots). With balance 1000 and small growth proj, proceed.

cases.name: missing_ctx_window_with_flag_fails_closed
cases.description: Same legacy row, but requireCtxWindow=true (Phase 1C flag-on). Guard must DENY rather than silently let an unbounded model through. P1.3 fix.

cases.name: low_balance_high_worstCase_denies_early
cases.description: Balance 500, but Opus worstCase = 200K × 15/1k + 64K × 75/1k = 7800 credits. Even with tiny actual usage so far, projection trips the guard immediately. This is the key invariant that closes -11305.

cases.name: exact_equal_consumed_balance_denies
cases.description: Edge: consumed exactly equals balance. The guard uses >= for the exhaust check so this denies (any further iter would over-spend by definition).

cases.name: lastDelta_dominant_with_no_worstCase_ceiling
cases.description: Model has null contextWindow → no worstCase ceiling. growth proj is small (avg over 6 iters of mostly-cheap calls), but lastDelta×2 catches the recent burst. Proves the lastDelta branch is non-redundant when worstCase is unavailable. Cumulative 200k @ 5/15 = ~1003 credits used. avg ≈ 33k×5+0.6k×15 = ~174 credits. lastDelta = 80k×5+0.5k×15 = ~407 → ×2 = ~815. Balance 1500 → consumed (~1003) + 815 = 1818 > 1500 → DENY via lastDelta.

cases.name: growth_dominant_when_lastDelta_is_zero
cases.description: lastDelta is zero (a free-cache hit on the previous iter), but cumulative growth+upcoming-avg projection trips the guard. Proves growth branch is non-redundant. cumulative=400k×5+5k×15 = 2075 credits. avg = 80k×5+1k×15 = 415 credits. lastDelta=0×2=0. worstCase=null. consumed (2075) + growth (415) = 2490 > 2400 balance → DENY via growth.

cases.name: byok_zero_rates_proceeds_when_under_balance
cases.description: BYOK case: rates are 0 (provider key, platform doesn't bill). consumed = 0, projection = 0 even with worstCase since worstCase is also 0. Guard proceeds - the platform doesn't bill BYOK calls, but the bridge guard also shouldn't block them.

cases.name: regression_2026_09_30_claude_code_cache_reads_priced_at_cache_rate
cases.description: Prod turn that was killed (user 141, 2026-09-30 08:39:55, claude-code/claude-sonnet-5-5 at the prod snapshot rates x 4/3). The guard used to price all 201,052 prompt tokens at the input rate: consumed=536.77 + next=310.43 > 733.57, DENY, while the ledger debited 112.44 for the whole turn. Cache-aware: 8 plain + 18,971 writes + 182,073 reads = 112.44 consumed; next = max(lastDelta x2 = 37.68, cache miss of the last call = 194.00) = 194.00; total 306.44 < 733.57, PROCEED.

cases.name: snapshot_without_cache_rates_keeps_the_pre_change_formula
cases.description: Same turn against a snapshot from an auth-service that predates the cache rates: the pre-change formula applies (536.77 + 310.43 > 733.57, DENY), so a guard deployed before auth-service behaves exactly as before, in either direction.

cases.name: cache_miss_projection_keeps_room_for_one_full_rewrite
cases.description: Same turn with 250 credits left. The cache-mix branches alone would allow the next call (112.44 + 37.68 = 150.12), but if it misses the cache it re-writes the 58,179 cached tokens at 1.25x input (194.00): 112.44 + 194.00 > 250, DENY. Without this branch one miss overdraws the balance by ~10x its projection.

cases.name: cache_aware_projection_still_denies_a_balance_it_would_exceed
cases.description: Same cache-heavy turn with 130 credits left: the real cost (112.44) plus the next-call projection exceeds the balance, so the guard still stops the run. Cache-aware pricing makes the projection accurate, it does not switch the guard off.

cases.name: anthropic_api_cache_counters_are_added_beside_the_prompt
cases.description: Direct Anthropic API reports input_tokens WITHOUT the cache (8 plain) and the cache beside it. The same turn costs 112.44, so 110 credits are already exhausted. Pricing the prompt alone (0.65) let a direct Anthropic run spend its cache unseen.

cases.name: anthropic_api_reserves_no_cache_miss
cases.description: Direct Anthropic API, same spend and cache as the killed turn, 200 credits left: 112.44 spent + max(growth 14.04, lastDelta x2 37.67) = 150.11, PROCEED. The pre-change guard never reserved anything for this path's additive cache, so the cache-miss branch is 0 here (a full-miss reservation of 194 would deny at 306.44). Same numbers on claude-code deny: see cache_miss_projection_keeps_room_for_one_full_rewrite.

cases.name: subset_provider_cached_tokens_priced_at_cache_read_rate
cases.description: Prod GPT Luna turn (codex, 2026-09-30 08:36, debited 5.1094): 115,668 prompt tokens of which 87,808 cached (a subset, OpenAI shape). Cache-aware consumed = 5.11; next = max(lastDelta x2 = 10.22, cache miss = the whole prompt at the input rate = 15.65); total 20.76 < 25, PROCEED. At the input rate it was 15.65 + 31.29 > 25, DENY.
